title.zh: 普京2026年5月19-20日访华：目的、成果与大三角关系走向的贝叶斯分析
title.en: Putin's May 2026 China Visit: Bayesian Analysis of Purposes, Outcomes, and Great-Power Triangle Trajectory

question.zh: 普京此次访华能否在象征性重申关系之外，达成实质性战略突破（能源大单、乌克兰和平路线图、或联合反霸体系）？
question.en: Will Putin's visit achieve substantial strategic breakthroughs (major energy deal, Ukraine peace roadmap, or joint anti-hegemony framework) beyond symbolic reaffirmation of ties?

current_state.zh: 特朗普刚于5月14-15日结束访华，成果有限（无联合声明、未延长贸易休战、未解决伊朗/乌克兰问题）。普京紧随其后于5月19-20日访华。俄方存在战略焦虑（担心中美走近削弱俄罗斯地位）。中俄贸易稳定在2000亿美元以上，西伯利亚力量-1运行良好，但力量-2管道因价格分歧仍未敲定。乌克兰冲突持续，普京宣称'接近尾声'。中东美伊战争持续，霍尔木兹海峡遭封锁。
current_state.en: Trump just concluded his China visit (May 14-15) with limited results (no joint statement, no trade truce extension, no breakthroughs on Iran/Ukraine). Putin follows immediately (May 19-20). Russia has strategic anxiety about US-China rapprochement. China-Russia trade is stable above $200B. Power of Siberia-1 runs well, but Power of Siberia-2 remains stalled on pricing. Ukraine conflict continues; Putin claims it is 'nearing its end.' The US-Israel war with Iran continues with the Strait of Hormuz blockaded.

hypothesis.zh: 普京此次访华将达成至少两项实质性战略突破（包括但不限于：西伯利亚力量-2框架协议、乌克兰和平路线图联合倡议、中东停火联合声明、或新的能源定价机制），而不仅是象征性重申战略伙伴关系。
hypothesis.en: Putin's visit will yield at least two substantive strategic breakthroughs (including but not limited to: Power of Siberia-2 framework agreement, joint Ukraine peace roadmap, joint Middle East ceasefire statement, or new energy pricing mechanism), beyond symbolic reaffirmation of the strategic partnership.

time_horizon.zh: 访问结束后1个月内（2026年5月20日-6月20日）观察成果落实情况
time_horizon.en: Within 1 month after the visit (May 20 - June 20, 2026) to observe implementation

decision_deadline.zh: 2026年5月19日（访问开始前形成判断）
decision_deadline.en: May 19, 2026 (form judgment before the visit begins)

success_metric.zh: 访问后发布的联合声明或签署文件中，明确包含至少两项可验证的实质性战略协议（非笼统表述）
success_metric.en: The joint statement or signed documents after the visit explicitly contain at least two verifiable substantive strategic agreements (not vague language)

source_summary.zh: 参考类：2022-2025年间普京与习近平的历次会晤成果。2022年2月北京冬奥会期间签署了'无上限'伙伴关系声明但缺乏具体执行机制；2023年3月莫斯科会晤发布了联合声明但实质性突破有限；2023年10月一带一路峰会期间主要成果为贸易便利化；2024年5月普京访华签署了多项协议但西伯利亚力量-2仍未敲定；2024年10月喀山金砖峰会协调了多边立场但缺乏双边重大突破。历史模式显示：中俄峰会'象征性成果充足，实质性突破稀少'。
source_summary.en: Reference class: Putin-Xi summit outcomes 2022-2025. Feb 2022 Beijing Olympics produced 'no limits' partnership rhetoric but few concrete mechanisms. Mar 2023 Moscow summit yielded joint statement but limited substance. Oct 2023 BRI forum focused on trade facilitation. May 2024 Putin visit produced multiple agreements but Power of Siberia-2 remained unresolved. Oct 2024 BRICS Kazan coordinated multilateral positions but lacked major bilateral breakthroughs. Historical pattern: China-Russia summits produce 'abundant symbolic outcomes, scarce substantive breakthroughs.'

source_summary.zh: 中俄谈判的结构性约束：中国在能源谈判中掌握主动权（俄气无替代市场）；中国坚持独立自主外交，不会与俄罗斯正式结盟；中俄在关键领域（能源定价、技术转让、军事合作深度）存在利益分歧。
source_summary.en: Structural constraints: China holds the upper hand in energy negotiations (Gazprom has no alternative market); China maintains independent foreign policy and will not formally ally with Russia; China and Russia have divergent interests in key areas (energy pricing, technology transfer, depth of military cooperation).

source_summary.zh: 特殊情境因素：俄方此次战略焦虑更强（中美刚结束对话），俄方需求更迫切；中东危机为能源合作提供了新推力；但特朗普访华成果有限反而减轻了俄方的焦虑程度。综合判断：先验概率略高于历史基线，但仍偏向保守。
source_summary.en: Situational factors: Russia's strategic anxiety is higher this time (US-China just concluded dialogue), making Russian demands more urgent; the Middle East crisis adds new impetus for energy cooperation; but Trump's limited results actually reduce Russia's anxiety level. Overall: prior slightly above historical baseline but still conservative.

name.zh: 特朗普访华成果有限（无联合声明、无贸易休战延期）
name.en: Trump visit yielded limited results (no joint statement, no trade truce extension)

summary.zh: 特朗普5月14-15日访华被广泛评价为'重形式轻实质'，未签署联合声明，未延长10月贸易休战协议，未在伊朗或乌克兰问题上取得突破。这减轻了俄方对中美缓和的担忧，降低了普京做出重大让步的紧迫性。
summary.en: Trump's May 14-15 visit was widely assessed as 'pageantry over policy' — no joint statement, no trade truce extension, no breakthroughs on Iran or Ukraine. This reduces Russian anxiety about US-China rapprochement and lowers Putin's urgency to make major concessions.

notes.zh: 多家权威媒体（AP、France24、NYMag）一致评估。方向为'削弱'假设：因为俄方焦虑减轻→普京让步动力降低→达成实质性协议的概率下降。
notes.en: Consistent assessment across multiple authoritative sources (AP, France24, NYMag). Direction is 'against' because reduced anxiety → lower Putin concession incentive → lower probability of substantive deals.

name.zh: 中东危机（美伊战争、霍尔木兹海峡封锁）提升陆路能源战略价值
name.en: Middle East crisis (US-Iran war, Strait of Hormuz blockade) increases strategic value of land-based energy

summary.zh: 中国约30%的LNG进口来自中东，海上能源通道风险凸显。俄管道气价格（约249美元/千立方米）远低于中国LNG进口均价（400美元+）。中东危机为西伯利亚力量-2提供了强大的战略推力。
summary.en: China imports ~30% of its LNG from the Middle East; maritime energy routes are at risk. Russian pipeline gas (~$249/thousand m³) is far cheaper than China's average LNG import price ($400+). The Middle East crisis provides strong strategic push for Power of Siberia-2.

notes.zh: 数据来源：The Moscow Times (5月13日分析)、S&P Global、中国海关数据。此证据支持假设，因为能源安全紧迫性可能促使中国在价格谈判中更灵活。
notes.en: Data sources: The Moscow Times (May 13 analysis), S&P Global, China customs data. Supports hypothesis because energy security urgency may make China more flexible in price negotiations.

name.zh: 普京宣称俄乌冲突'接近尾声'并愿与泽连斯基会晤
name.en: Putin states Ukraine conflict is 'nearing its end' and is willing to meet Zelensky

summary.zh: 普京在5月9日记者会上罕见表示冲突'正在接近尾声'，愿意与泽连斯基在莫斯科或第三国会晤（前提是已就和平协议达成一致）。这释放了结束战争的信号，增加了在外交场合（如访华期间）提出和平倡议的可能性。
summary.en: In a rare statement on May 9, Putin said the conflict is 'nearing its end' and expressed willingness to meet Zelensky in Moscow or a third country (provided a peace deal is already agreed). This signals openness to ending the war and increases the chance of a peace initiative during the China visit.

notes.zh: 来源：TASS、克里姆林宫记者会实录。依赖折扣设为0.80因普京的表态可能主要是宣传姿态而非真正让步信号。
notes.en: Sources: TASS, Kremlin press briefing transcript. Dependency discount of 0.80 because Putin's statements may primarily be propaganda rather than genuine concession signals.

name.zh: 历史模式：中俄峰会象征性成果充足、实质性突破稀少
name.en: Historical pattern: China-Russia summits produce abundant symbolic outcomes but few substantive breakthroughs

summary.zh: 回顾2022-2025年间的5次主要中俄峰会，每次都有联合声明和多项协议签署，但在关键领域（西伯利亚力量-2、军事同盟、联合反霸机制）始终未取得突破。中国坚持'不结盟、不对抗、不针对第三方'原则。
summary.en: Reviewing 5 major China-Russia summits from 2022-2025, each produced joint statements and multiple agreements, but key breakthroughs (Power of Siberia-2, military alliance, joint anti-hegemony mechanism) were consistently absent. China adheres to 'non-alignment, non-confrontation, non-targeting of third parties.'

notes.zh: 基于公开可查的峰会成果文件对比。这是最可靠的负面预测因子之一。高依赖折扣因为历史模式是稳定的结构性约束。
notes.en: Based on publicly available summit outcome document comparisons. One of the most reliable negative predictors. High dependency discount because historical pattern reflects stable structural constraints.

name.zh: 西伯利亚力量-2仍因价格分歧停滞，中方未列入五年规划明确时间表
name.en: Power of Siberia-2 still stalled on pricing; China's five-year plan lacks clear timeline

summary.zh: 中国2026-2030五年规划仅提及'推进中俄天然气管道中线路线的预备工作'，未给出明确时间表。多家分析机构预测最早投产时间为2030-2031年。关键技术细节（价格公式、投资分摊、蒙古过境费）均未解决。
summary.en: China's 2026-2030 five-year plan only mentions 'advancing preparatory work for the China-Russia gas pipeline middle route' without a clear timeline. Analysts project earliest operation in 2030-2031. Key technical details (pricing formula, investment sharing, Mongolia transit fees) remain unresolved.

notes.zh: 来源：S&P Global、The Moscow Times、中国五年规划文件。折扣设为0.75因峰会本身可能打破僵局（与历史模式相关但不完全重叠）。
notes.en: Sources: S&P Global, The Moscow Times, China's five-year plan documents. Discount of 0.75 because a summit can break deadlocks (correlated with but not fully overlapping with the historical pattern).

name.zh: 拉夫罗夫4月访华铺路，议程涵盖双边关系各项议题及国际事务
name.en: Lavrov's April visit to China paved the way; agenda covers all bilateral and international topics

summary.zh: 俄罗斯外长拉夫罗夫4月访华被视为普京访华的预备。双方已就广泛议题进行了技术层面准备。克里姆林宫确认'主要安排均已敲定'，普京将会晤习近平和李强。这显示访问经过充分准备，增加达成具体协议的可能性。
summary.en: Russian FM Lavrov visited China in April, seen as preparation for Putin's visit. Both sides have conducted technical-level preparations across a wide range of topics. The Kremlin confirms 'main arrangements are finalized,' and Putin will meet both Xi and Li Qiang. This shows thorough preparation, increasing the chance of concrete agreements.

notes.zh: 来源：俄罗斯卫星通讯社、中国外交部。折扣较低因'充分准备'不一定意味着'实质性突破'——历次峰会前都有类似铺路。
notes.en: Sources: Sputnik, Chinese Foreign Ministry. Lower discount because 'thorough preparation' doesn't necessarily mean 'substantive breakthroughs' — similar groundwork preceded all previous summits.

name.zh: 中俄双边贸易稳定在2000亿美元以上，本币结算比例持续提升
name.en: China-Russia bilateral trade stable above $200B with growing local-currency settlement

summary.zh: 双边经贸合作规模近年稳定在2000亿美元以上。本币结算比例已超过90%（人民币+卢布）。这为更深层次的金融合作（如自主能源定价机制）奠定了基础，降低了达成协议的阻力。
summary.en: Bilateral trade has stabilized above $200B in recent years. Local-currency settlement (RMB + ruble) has exceeded 90%. This lays the groundwork for deeper financial cooperation (e.g., independent energy pricing mechanism) and reduces friction in reaching agreements.

notes.zh: 来源：中国海关总署、俄罗斯央行数据。此证据与假设之间是弱到中等正相关。
notes.en: Sources: China General Administration of Customs, Russian Central Bank data. Weak-to-moderate positive correlation with the hypothesis.

name.zh: 中国战略定力：同时推进中美、中俄两条线，避免被任何一方绑定
name.en: China's strategic composure: advancing both US-China and Russia-China tracks without being tied to either

summary.zh: 中国坚持独立自主外交方针。在特朗普访华期间提出'建设性战略稳定'框架，同时维持与俄罗斯的战略协作。中国不会因为普京访华而做出损害中美关系缓和的重大让步，也不会因中美对话而冷落俄罗斯。这种平衡策略限制了在任何单一次峰会中达成突破性协议的意愿。
summary.en: China maintains an independent foreign policy. During Trump's visit, Xi proposed a 'constructive strategic stability' framework while preserving strategic coordination with Russia. China will neither make major concessions that damage US-China rapprochement for Putin, nor cold-shoulder Russia due to US-China dialogue. This balancing strategy limits the willingness to achieve breakthrough agreements at any single summit.

notes.zh: 基于中国外交政策长期模式的结构性判断，而非具体事件证据。属于专家分析级别（C级）。
notes.en: Structural judgment based on long-term patterns of Chinese foreign policy, not specific event evidence. Expert analysis level (Grade C).

name.zh: 高预期行动：预期此次访问将达成至少两项实质性战略突破
name.en: High-expectation: Expect at least two substantive strategic breakthroughs from this visit

name.zh: 基准预期行动：预期访问以象征性成果为主，保持中性预期
name.en: Baseline: Expect mostly symbolic outcomes; maintain neutral expectations

name.zh: 低预期行动：预期访问成果低于历史平均水平，降低预期
name.en: Low-expectation: Expect below-historical-average outcomes; reduce expectations

candidates.zh: 5月19日访问首日观察：联合声明的具体措辞和签署文件的数量/类型将是最重要的实时信号
candidates.en: May 19 first-day observation: The specific wording of the joint statement and the number/type of signed documents will be the most important real-time signals

candidates.zh: 关注能源协议细节：如果有西伯利亚力量-2的框架协议，检查是否包含定价公式或仅为意向性备忘录
candidates.en: Watch energy deal details: If there is a Power of Siberia-2 framework agreement, check whether it includes a pricing formula or is only an MOU

candidates.zh: 关注乌克兰相关措辞：联合声明中关于乌克兰的表述是否超出以往'通过对话解决'的笼统表述
candidates.en: Watch Ukraine language: Whether the joint statement on Ukraine goes beyond the usual 'resolve through dialogue' boilerplate

initial_state.zh: 用户提供了大量关于普京访华的情报（包括访问背景、关键议题、历史模式、地缘环境），并要求进行贝叶斯分析。Skill 将问题结构化为三个层次：核心假设验证、各项成果概率评估、大三角关系走向判断。
initial_state.en: The user provided extensive intelligence on Putin's visit (background, key topics, historical patterns, geopolitical context) and requested Bayesian analysis. The skill structured the problem into three levels: core hypothesis testing, per-outcome probability assessment, and great-power triangle trajectory judgment.

stage.zh: 初始结构化与弱先验设定
stage.en: Initial structuring and weak prior setting

user_input_summary.zh: 用户提供了完整的普京访华背景情报，要求分析：1) 访华首要目的概率排序；2) 各项核心成果达成的可能性；3) 中美俄大三角关系走向。
user_input_summary.en: User provided comprehensive background intelligence on Putin's visit, requesting analysis of: 1) probability ranking of primary purposes; 2) likelihood of each core outcome; 3) US-China-Russia triangle trajectory.

assistant_focus.zh: 将模糊问题转化为可计算的假设、设定基于历史模式的弱先验、构建证据链
assistant_focus.en: Converting fuzzy questions into computable hypotheses, setting weak priors based on historical patterns, constructing evidence chains

new_information.zh: 特朗普访华成果有限（无联合声明、无贸易休战延期）→ 减轻俄方焦虑
new_information.en: Trump visit yielded limited results → reduces Russian anxiety

new_information.zh: 中东危机（霍尔木兹海峡封锁）→ 提升陆路管道战略价值
new_information.en: Middle East crisis (Strait of Hormuz blockade) → increases strategic value of land pipelines

new_information.zh: 普京宣称冲突'接近尾声'→ 释放可能的和谈信号
new_information.en: Putin claims conflict 'nearing its end' → signals possible peace openness

new_information.zh: 历史模式：中俄峰会象征性成果多、实质性突破少
new_information.en: Historical pattern: China-Russia summits — abundant symbolic outcomes, scarce substance

new_information.zh: 西伯利亚力量-2仍因价格分歧停滞
new_information.en: Power of Siberia-2 still stalled on pricing

new_information.zh: 拉夫罗夫4月铺路访问 → 访问经过充分准备
new_information.en: Lavrov's April preparatory visit → thorough preparation

new_information.zh: 中俄贸易稳定在2000亿美元+，本币结算超90%
new_information.en: China-Russia trade stable above $200B, local currency settlement >90%

new_information.zh: 中国战略定力：同时推进中美和中俄两条线
new_information.en: China's strategic composure: advancing both US and Russia tracks simultaneously

interim_judgment.zh: 初步判断：正面证据（中东危机推力、普京和平信号、充分准备）和负面证据（历史模式约束、价格分歧持续、中国战略定力、特朗普成果有限减轻焦虑）大致平衡。后验概率略低于先验，因为负面证据的似然比总和略强于正面证据。整体结论：此次访问大概率仍以象征性成果为主，但中东危机可能推动能源合作取得超过历史水平的进展。
interim_judgment.en: Preliminary judgment: Supporting evidence (Middle East crisis push, Putin peace signals, thorough preparation) and opposing evidence (historical pattern constraints, ongoing pricing disputes, China's strategic composure, Trump's limited results reducing anxiety) roughly balance. Posterior slightly below prior because opposing evidence has a slightly stronger combined likelihood ratio. Overall: the visit will likely still be primarily symbolic, but the Middle East crisis may push energy cooperation beyond historical levels.

bayes_update.formula_zh: 从先验概率 30.0% (odds=0.429) 出发，依次乘以8条证据的校正似然比，得到后验 odds 约 0.389，对应概率约 28.0%。负面证据（历史模式、价格分歧、中国战略定力）的综合影响力略强于正面证据（中东危机、普京和平信号）。
bayes_update.formula_en: Starting from prior probability 30.0% (odds=0.429), sequentially multiplying by the calibrated likelihood ratios of 8 evidence items yields posterior odds ~0.389, corresponding to probability ~28.0%. Opposing evidence (historical pattern, pricing disputes, China's strategic composure) has a slightly stronger combined effect than supporting evidence (Middle East crisis, Putin peace signals).
